focus_areas: Texture authenticity of the red topping
Distinction between soft-serve swirls and hand-scooped geometry
Boundary sharpness and physical contact of the wafer garnish
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red topping; does its texture look like real fruit/sorbet or digital noise? Also, evaluate if the white base looks like extruded soft-serve (ridges) or scooped ice cream (shear planes), as this affects the 'scoop marks' checkpoint validity. Specifically check the wafer edge for 'melting' into the ice cream, which indicates a structural artifact.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black bowl containing a white frozen dessert, likely vanilla ice cream or soft serve. The dessert is topped with a bright red, textured garnish (resembling a sorbet ball or fruit puree) and a thin, pinkish wafer or cookie shard. A wooden stick handle protrudes from the top right.
